subject: Audit logs & evidence request - access logs, retention, export format
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@fincobank.com>, Priya Mehta <priya.mehta@fincobank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Audit logs & evidence request - access logs, retention, export format

Hi Tom / Priya -

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and next steps so we're all aligned: 

1) What you asked for (audit/evidence):
   - A sample of the audit log export showing who accessed model inference logs and when (user id, role, timestamp, action, resource).
   - Confirmation of retention windows for those logs and how they're archived/soft-deleted.
   - Export formats available (CSV, JSON) and schema.
   - Evidence of role-based access controls (who can export logs) - an access matrix or policy excerpt.

2) Redwood next steps:
   - I'll assemble a sanitized sample export and an access matrix PDF for you to review.
   - Marissa will coordinate any audit artifacts and coordinate with our infra team if you need additional timestamps or raw event IDs.

3) Questions we have for you:
   - Do you need these logs in a specific CSV schema or a particular timezone for timestamps?
   - Is there a preferred transfer mechanism (SFTP, secure Drive link, or we can deliver via your attest portal)?

I'm attaching a short checklist we'll use to produce the sample. If that looks good I'll send the sanitized export by EOD.

Best,

Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: evidence_request_checklist.pdf (PDF, 42KB)]

From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@fincobank.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Mehta <priya.mehta@fincobank.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit logs & evidence request - access logs, retention, export format

Sean -

Thanks for the recap and quick turnaround. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Schema: CSV is preferred; columns we need are at minimum: timestamp (ISO 8601), user_email, user_role, action (read/export/update), resource_path, request_id. If you can include a separate column for model_version that would be helpful.
- Timezone: UTC for timestamps please.
- Transfer: secure Drive link is fine for the sample; for full deliverables we may request SFTP or upload to our vendor portal depending on procurement.
- Redaction: please sanitize any customer-identifying data (PII) but keep request_id and resource_path so we can validate event sequences.

Also, can you confirm your retention policy for audit logs (default retention length and archival procedure) and whether logs are immutable once written (WORM-like behavior) or mutable?

Priya - can you loop in procurement for any vendor evidence requests or a security questionnaire if needed?

Thanks,
Tom
Director, IT Risk & Compliance
FinCo Bank

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@fincobank.com>, Priya Mehta <priya.mehta@fincobank.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit logs & evidence request - access logs, retention, export format

Looping in Aditya (infra) to generate the sample export and confirm retention details. Aditya - can you produce a sanitized CSV sample following Tom's column list (UTC timestamps, include model_version) and attach an access_matrix.pdf that shows RBAC policies for log exports? If you can include a short note about immutability/append-only behavior and where the logs are archived (S3 bucket + lifecycle), that will help.

Target: send sample + access matrix to Tom by 17:30 PT today. If anything requires legal/procurement signoff we'll escalate.

Thanks -
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@fincobank.com>, Priya Mehta <priya.mehta@fincobank.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 17:38:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Audit logs - sample export and access matrix

Tom / Priya -

Per today's request, attached is a sanitized sample CSV export and our access matrix PDF. Notes below: 

- audit_log_sample.csv: contains columns timestamp_utc, user_email, user_role, action, resource_path, request_id, model_version. All customer identifiers have been redacted and replaced with tokenized IDs (cust_####).
- access_matrix.pdf: shows the roles that are permitted to view/export audit logs (Engineering Ops, Security Admins, Customer Success for specific support workflows).
- Retention: default audit log retention is 365 days in our primary S3 bucket. Older logs are moved to Glacier after 365 days and are retained for a total of 7 years by default for enterprise accounts when requested.
- Immutability: logs are append-only in our ingestion pipeline. Stored objects have versioning enabled and delete operations are soft deletes that set lifecycle markers; we can provide object version IDs if you need raw evidence.
- Export formats: CSV and JSON are available via the console and API. Large exports are delivered as gzipped CSV.

[Attachment: audit_log_sample.csv (CSV, 120KB)]
[Attachment: access_matrix.pdf (PDF, 85KB)]

If you want the raw object version IDs or a signed S3 pre-signed URL for direct download into your SFTP, let us know and we'll produce that under an NDA/procurement channel.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Infra Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference
